title: Canonical Facts Contract (L0) Schema
description: The L0 extraction contract for capturing immutable, source-faithful observations with absolute provenance.

subject.description: The exact name of the entity as identified in the report, unified for identity stability.

predicate.description: A stable canonical reporting term or organization-specific metric (e.g., turnover, ebitda, mpesa_capacity_tps).

object.description: The literal extracted value reflecting the document exactly as written.

unit.description: The explicit unit of measure provided in the document, or null if not applicable.

period.description: The reporting period associated with the fact (e.g., FY2025).

confidence.description: The extraction confidence level, typically 1.0 for explicit observations.

source.description: Provenance metadata for independent verification of the fact.

document.description: The filename of the original source document.

page.description: The exact page number within the source document.

section.description: The verbatim title of the report section where the fact was identified.

context.description: The original lexical snippet/fragment containing the fact to preserve source fidelity.
